title: Canonical Header Seam Machine
statement: For every machine format $F$, there exist a finite Turing machine $C$ over the Boolean alphabet with at least one work tape, entry and exit states, and a constant $a\\in\\mathbb N$. On every Boolean input $\\alpha$, it reaches within $t\\le a(|\\alpha|+1)$ steps, where $t>0$, the configuration with the exit state, the canonical header of $\\alpha$ on tape zero, and empty words on all other tapes; the input head is at position $1$ and the output is empty. At every earlier time $u<t$ its state is not the exit state.
hypotheses_covered: no earlier visit to the exit state
final configuration has canonical header on tape zero, other tapes blank, input head at 1, and empty output
